purpose: Known, bounded Requirements Lab export and usability issues. This ledger is evidence about the pinned export; it does not rewrite or silently remap Lab requirement identifiers.
export_policy: The pinned 2025 Requirements Lab export remains the source of truth. Re-run synchronization only when the pinned export changes; record recurrences as a new issue id.

issues.title: Page-132 object-management postconditions inherit the following 6.18.1 heading
issues.symptom: The generated requirement statements describe Delete Object Instance postconditions (including the Flush Queue Request and disable-time-constrained cases), but the semantic export labels both records as clause 6.18.1, the subsequent Local Delete Object Instance service.
issues.impact: A direct gap query can report the requirements under the wrong subsection and a test mapping must not silently replace the exported clause. This can make a correct implementation look uncovered or attach evidence to the wrong standard section.
issues.workaround: Keep the stable Lab ids and exported clause in traceability data; record the source-heading correction here and use the pinned source page when selecting or reviewing a focused test. Do not mutate the Lab export in the RTI repository.
